# Curriculum map

**Who this is for:** teachers, schools, partners and content authors who want to see exactly what the game covers.
**Last checked against:** BUILD 2026-10-25 18:32 UTC. Generated by `node tools/make-curriculum-map.mjs` from `src/grade1.js` … `src/grade9.js` (unit and skill titles and blurbs as children see them). Don't edit by hand.

Every skill has a 3–5 card lesson ending in a worked example, and questions at three levels; level 3 is the full Cambridge stage expectation. Every unit ends with a boss round. See [learning-design.md](learning-design.md) for how mastery works.

| Grade | Units | Skills |
|---|---|---|
| 1 (Primary Stage 1) | 5 | 20 |
| 2 (Primary Stage 2) | 5 | 20 |
| 3 (Primary Stage 3) | 5 | 22 |
| 4 (Primary Stage 4) | 5 | 24 |
| 5 (Primary Stage 5) | 5 | 25 |
| 6 (Primary Stage 6) | 6 | 22 |
| 7 (Lower Secondary Stage 7) | 5 | 23 |
| 8 (Lower Secondary Stage 8) | 6 | 22 |
| 9 (Lower Secondary Stage 9) | 6 | 23 |
| **Total** | **48** | **201** |

## Grade 1 — Primary Stage 1

### 🔢 Numbers to 20

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🍎 Count to 20 | Count things one by one, up to 20 |
| ➡️ Before and after | Find the number before or after, count on and back |
| ⚖️ More or fewer | Which is more? Which is fewer? Which is bigger? |
| 📶 Put in order | Put numbers in order, smallest to biggest |
| 🧱 Teen numbers | A teen number is 10 and some ones |
| 🦘 Count in 2s, 5s, 10s | Count in jumps of 2, 5 or 10 |

### ➕ Add and take away

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🔗 Number bonds | Two numbers that make 5 or 10 |
| ➕ Adding | Add by counting on from the bigger number |
| ➖ Taking away | Take away by counting back |
| ❓ Missing numbers | Find the number hiding in the box |
| 👯 Doubles and halves | Double means two the same. Half means share in 2. |
| 📖 Story problems | Read the story, look at the picture, find the answer |

### 🔺 Shapes and patterns

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🟦 Flat shapes | Circle, triangle, square and rectangle |
| 🧊 Solid shapes | Cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder and cone |
| 🔁 Patterns | Find what comes next in a pattern |

### ⏰ Measure, time, money

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 📏 Long and heavy | Longer or shorter? Heavier or lighter? |
| 🕒 Telling the time | Read o'clock and half past on a clock |
| 🪙 Money | Know coins and notes, and add small amounts |

### 📊 Halves and charts

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🍕 Halves | Two parts the same size. Half of a group. |
| 📊 Pictograms and tallies | Read pictograms and tally charts |

## Grade 2 — Primary Stage 2

### 🔢 Numbers to 100

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🐸 Counting and patterns | Count on and back, and count in 2s, 5s and 10s |
| 🧱 Tens and ones | Split a number into tens and ones |
| ⚖️ Compare and order | Use <, > and = to compare numbers |
| 🧦 Odd and even | Find odd and even numbers |

### ➕ Add and subtract

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🔗 Number bonds | Pairs of numbers that make 10, 20 and 100 |
| 🔟 Add and subtract tens | Add or take away tens, like 34 + 10 and 58 − 20 |
| 🎯 Add and subtract ones | Like 46 + 7 and 53 − 8, going through a ten |
| 🧮 Two 2-digit numbers | Add and subtract numbers like 34 + 25 and 67 − 23 |
| ❓ Missing numbers | Find the number hiding in the box |
| 📖 Word problems | Read a story, then add or take away |

### ✖️ Multiply and divide

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🟦 Equal groups and arrays | Multiply using equal groups, arrays and adding again |
| 🔁 The 2, 5 and 10 tables | Know facts like 7 × 2, 4 × 5 and 6 × 10 |
| 👯 Doubling and halving | Double means 2 times as many. Half means 2 equal parts. |
| 🍪 Sharing and grouping | Share things out equally, or put them into equal groups |

### 🍕 Fractions

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🥧 Halves and quarters | Find a half, a quarter and three quarters of a shape |
| 🍬 Fractions of amounts | Find a half, a quarter or three quarters of a number |

### 📏 Measure, shape, data

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🕒 Telling the time | O'clock, half past, quarter past and quarter to |
| 💰 Money | Add up coins and notes, and work out change |
| 🔺 2D and 3D shapes | Name shapes and count sides, corners and faces |
| 📊 Pictograms and charts | Read pictograms, tally charts and block charts |

### 🔢 Numbers to 1000

### ➕ Add and subtract

| Skill | What the child does |

| 🧮 Column addition | Add 3-digit numbers in columns, with carrying |
| ➖ Column subtraction | Take away 3-digit numbers in columns, with exchanging |
| 🔍 Estimate and check | Round to estimate, then check your answers |
| 🧩 Two-step problems | Solve word problems that need two steps |

### ✖️ Multiply and divide

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| ✖️ Times tables | The 2, 3, 4, 5, 8 and 10 tables and division facts |
| 🔲 2-digit × 1-digit | Multiply numbers like 23 × 4 by splitting them |
| 🍪 Division with remainders | Share and group, and find what is left over |

### 🍕 Fractions

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🍕 Fractions of shapes | Name the fraction of a shape that is shaded |
| 🍬 Fractions of amounts | Find a fraction of a number, like ¾ of 20 |
| 🟰 Equivalent fractions | Find equal fractions, compare them and add them |

### 📏 Measure, shape, data

| Skill | What the child does |
|---|---|
| 🕒 Telling the time | Read clocks to 5 minutes and work out how long |
| 📏 Length, mass, capacity | Choose units, change units and read scales |
| 💰 Money and change | Add up money and work out change |
| 🔷 2D shapes and symmetry | Name shapes, find right angles and lines of symmetry |
| 🧊 3D shapes | Name 3D shapes and count faces, edges and vertices |
| 📊 Charts and sorting | Read bar charts and pictograms, and sort numbers |
